steps.spoken: Hard-boil the 3 eggs for about 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Chop the eggs into small pieces.
steps.spoken: Chop the eggs into small pieces. Larger pieces of egg white often fail to mix with the butter.

steps.instruction: Mix the chopped eggs with 4 tablespoons of softened butter.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Use it as a sandwich spread.
